interval_take: Dhurandhar: The Revenge crossed Dhurandhar 1's lifetime collection (₹840.20 Cr) on its 2nd Sunday — Day 11. India gross crossed ₹1,000 Cr the same day. The second weekend delivered ₹172.60 Cr (D9 ₹41.75 + D10 ₹62.85 + D11 ₹68 Cr) — more than some films make in their entire run. In North America, D2 has crossed Baahubali 2's all-time NA collection at $23M, becoming the highest-grossing Indian film ever in that market.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
